# Mockups: three directions as real pages

1. Read `.factory/playbook/04-mockups.md` and follow it step by step. It is the source of truth; this file only points to it.
2. Also read `.factory/playbook/taste-guide.md`.

## Do not skip

- Make the directions different in layout, type and color, not three palettes on one layout.
- No invented claims and no look-alike stock: bracketed draft copy and labeled placeholders only.
- Look at every direction at 390 and 1440 wide before opening the pull request.

## Done when

One pull request with phone and desktop screenshots of each direction. Steven's merge is his taste pass.

The factory rules in `AGENTS.md` apply throughout: stop only for a gate or the pause list, and say in the handoff what you did not verify.
